target_customer: Pharma companies running global drug launches, pricing and market access
problem: Launch teams spend weeks gathering regulatory, HTA and pricing evidence across countries; Cellbyte answers these questions with traceable AI agents.
business_model: Enterprise SaaS platform plus expert-led evidence reviews and pricing analyses
product_category: AI platform for pharma market access and pricing

founders.name: Felix Steinbrenner
previous_startups: Glocally (YC W22, same-day delivery, pivoted in 2023)
founders.background_notes: Sold enterprise deals to H&M at Glocally.

founders.name: Daniel Moreira
founders.background_notes: Five years in life sciences consulting; the idea came from this work.

competitors.name: EVERSANA NAVLIN
competitors.what: Price and market access software ecosystem across 100+ countries

technical_complexity.rationale: Multilingual document extraction and a curated clinical, regulatory and HTA database with traceable outputs is hard data work but built on available AI.

defensibility.rationale: Proprietary curated database, ISO 27001 compliance and pharma trust help, though large data vendors could add similar AI.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Competitors added AI features in 2025 and 2026 but no acquisition of Cellbyte found.

market_need_then: Launch failure is costly and consultancies charge heavily for pricing and access analyses; the founders came from Simon-Kucher and saw this directly.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, efficiency-focused and trust-oriented: Pharma runs on trust. So do we.

branding.brand_signature: Pharma runs on trust tagline and compliance badges

rebrands.why: Pivot from last-mile delivery to pharma AI; entity rename claim from a single third-party site, unverified

brand_strength.rationale: A distinctive, sector-fitting name with trust-led messaging, named pharma customers and German startup press coverage, but no independent brand press.

pivots.why: Founders concluded Glocally would not reach profitability in the foreseeable future.

outcome_analysis: Cellbyte is the survivor of Glocally, a YC W22 delivery startup that pivoted in mid 2023 into AI for pharma pricing and market access. A consulting-sourced insight, named customers such as Bayer and Gilead, a claimed 8 of the top 20 pharma firms and a $2.75M seed in November 2025 show a successful pivot. Customer claims come from the company site, and rivals now add AI features.
notes: Seed is corroborated by multiple outlets (PharmiWeb press release, PharmaTimes, Munich Startup at 2.4M euros); Seedtable lists YC as lead at $2.8M, which conflicts with the press release naming Frontline as lead. The competitor listed is dated to the W22 batch era, but the company actually started building the pharma product after the 2023 pivot, so competition at that point would also include Access Infinity and others not dated. Founding year follows the YC batch.
